p1: Maya Deshpande is a 34-year-old park ranger based in Flagstaff, Arizona, who loves trail running, astrophotography, and desert-native gardening.
p10: Tessa Bell is a 31-year-old set and props buyer for a repertory theatre in Wellington, New Zealand, living with a flatmate and spending her off-hours on kite-making, tidepool sketching, and community table-tennis nights.
p11: Rafael Costa is a 43-year-old elevator inspector in Recife, Brazil, divorced and living in a mid-rise apartment near Boa Viagem, with hobbies that include capoeira angola, building intricate paper models of historic buildings, and keeping a meticulous notebook of tropical storm patterns.
p12: Anika Voss is a 24-year-old apprentice farrier in Inverness, Scotland, sharing a rented cottage on the outskirts of town and spending her free time on traditional archery, coastal tide-timetables, and hand-tool leatherworking.
p13: Yara Benali is a 41-year-old independent perfumer in Tangier, Morocco, living with her spouse and school-age son, and she spends her free time studying Andalusi music, practicing geometric zellige pattern drawing, and taking the ferry across the strait on quiet Sundays.
p14: Elin Sørensen is a 36-year-old lighthouse conservator based in Tromsø, Norway, living with her partner in a yellow wooden rowhouse and spending her free time on sea-ice sketching, traditional nalbinding, and volunteering at a coastal heritage boat shed.
p15: Carmen Ruiz is a 58-year-old vineyard irrigation scheduler in Mendoza, Argentina, recently settled into a quieter post-divorce life, and she spends her free time on Andean cloud photography, repairing bandoneons, and cultivating heirloom melons.
p2: Jonas Eklund is a 62-year-old high-school choir director in Burlington, Vermont, who enjoys Nordic skiing, restoring old fountain pens, and baking rye bread.
p3: Leila Haddad is a 27-year-old aquarium life-support technician in Halifax, Nova Scotia, who spends her free time sea-kayaking, mending vintage denim, and learning conversational Korean.
p4: Priya Nair is a 45-year-old probate attorney in Savannah, Georgia, raising a teenage son and spending her spare time on ceramic wheel-throwing, local history walking tours, and backyard birdwatching.
p5: Nadia Petrescu is a 19-year-old first-year marine engineering cadet in Constanta, Romania, who lives in a student dorm and spends her free time on indoor bouldering, analog synth tinkering, and learning Turkish cooking.
p6: Owen McBride is a 51-year-old municipal archivist in Eugene, Oregon, recently remarried and deeply into accordion music, mushroom foraging, and neighborhood radio-history projects.
p7: Sofía Álvarez is a 38-year-old neonatal intensive care nurse in Albuquerque, New Mexico, living with her partner and young daughter, and she’s into hot-air balloon festivals, weaving on a rigid-heddle loom, and weekend adobe home projects.
p8: Imani Okafor is a 29-year-old urban beekeeper and small-batch honey producer in Glasgow, Scotland, renting a top-floor flat and spending her free time on lino-printmaking, canal-side cycling, and collecting West African cookbooks.
p9: Haruto Sakamoto is a 56-year-old court stenographer in Kyoto, Japan, whose empty-nest life revolves around rakugo performances, repairing mechanical watches, and tending a small balcony bonsai collection.
